    Inflation along quotient maps and central idempotents #

    For a surjective ring homomorphism π : B → C, inflation ModuleCat.restrictScalars π : Mod C ⥤ Mod B is fully faithful (restrictScalars_full); for a k-algebra map it is k-linear and keeps the underlying k-vector space (dim_restrictScalars).

    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars π).Full

    Inflation along a surjective ring homomorphism is full.
